name: Portree
method: tidetimes.org.uk Portree vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Ullapool. tidetimes' Portree is Ullapool moved 25 min to the minute, so times are as good as Ullapool's. Heights sit ~0.15 m above tidetimes, the same gap as our Ullapool gauge fit vs UKHO (mean sea level epoch). Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Portree vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-19 (every 3 day(s), 544 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
